positions.name: HandOffOverlapSizing
positions.frame: How long should the overlap call at each intake hand-off be, given the open cases and the arrivals it has to cover?
positions.why: Both statements read the hand-off overlap call as a sized quantity measured against its workload. src-1 states the settled change: the rota stays fortnightly and the overlap grows from fifteen to thirty minutes. src-2 gives the reason: fifteen minutes covered the open cases but not the ones that arrived during the hand-off week. The frame holds both the decision and the shortfall that motivates it. Nothing here is in tension.
